# Importables

An `import.json` file declares the Housing objects HTSW should create or update.
Those objects are called importables. Functions, events, regions, items, menus,
commands, NPCs, teams, and groups are all importables.

Check the complete project through its entry file:

```sh
htsw check import.json
```

## Top-level fields

<!-- importables-schema:top-level START -->
<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-importables-doc.mjs. Do not edit this block. -->

| Field | Required | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `houseUuid` | No | UUID string |
| `include` | No | array of path ending in `import.json` or `.import.json` |
| `functions` | No | array of function object |
| `events` | No | array of event object |
| `regions` | No | array of region object |
| `items` | No | array of item object |
| `menus` | No | array of menu object |
| `teams` | No | array of team object |
| `groups` | No | array of group object |
| `commands` | No | array of command object |
| `npcs` | No | array of NPC object |

<!-- importables-schema:top-level END -->

Every collection is optional. An entry file can contain any combination of
them and can pull in more files through `include`.

```json
{
  "houseUuid": "5e9c8f33-1234-4abc-9def-0123456789ab",
  "include": ["core/import.json", "games/parkour.import.json"],
  "functions": [],
  "events": [],
  "regions": [],
  "items": [],
  "menus": [],
  "commands": [],
  "npcs": [],
  "teams": [],
  "groups": []
}
```

`houseUuid` binds the project to one Housing. Only the entry file's value is
used; a value in an included file is ignored. Binding lets the in-game tools
select the right destination and prevents Auto-Track from acting while you are
in a different house.

Paths are resolved relative to the `import.json` that declares them. Action
fields point to `.htsl` files, item fields point to `.snbt` files, and `include`
accepts nested `import.json` or `*.import.json` files. A file reached through
more than one include is merged only once.

## Shared import behavior

Importing is additive: HTSW creates or updates the importables declared by the
project but does not delete other Housing objects merely because they are
absent from `import.json`.

Most importables are matched by `name`. Events are matched by `event`, and NPCs
are matched by `pos`. Changing a name therefore creates a different function,
region, item, menu, command, team, or group; changing an NPC's name does not
change its coordinate-based identity.

For standalone action fields such as function `actions`, region entry actions,
or NPC click actions, omitting the field leaves that action list unchanged. A
declared `.htsl` file containing no actions clears the list. Event actions are
always required. Menu `slots` describe the complete desired slot layout, so a
slot without `actions` has an empty action list and live slots omitted from the
array are removed.

## Function

<!-- importables-schema:functionImportable START -->
<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-importables-doc.mjs. Do not edit this block. -->

Nested fields marked required are required whenever their containing object is present.

| Field | Required | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Yes | string |
| `actions` | No | path ending in `.htsl` |
| `description` | No | string |
| `repeatTicks` | No | number from 4 to 18000 |
| `icon` | No | function icon object |
| `icon.item` | Yes | string |
| `icon.count` | No | integer from 1 to 64 |
| `icon.enchanted` | No | boolean |

<!-- importables-schema:functionImportable END -->

Functions are matched by `name`. `actions` may be omitted when only the
function's settings or an empty function shell are needed.

`description` sets the description shown in Housing's function list.
`repeatTicks` makes the function repeat at that interval. Omitting it means the
function does not repeat. Omitting `description` or `icon` leaves the existing
setting unchanged; a new function uses Housing's defaults.

```json
{
  "functions": [
    {
      "name": "Loop 10t",
      "actions": "src/loop_10t.htsl",
      "description": "Updates the game loop.",
      "repeatTicks": 10,
      "icon": {
        "item": "minecraft:clock",
        "count": 10,
        "enchanted": true
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Event

<!-- importables-schema:eventImportable START -->
<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-importables-doc.mjs. Do not edit this block. -->

| Field | Required | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `event` | Yes | one of 18 accepted strings |
| `actions` | Yes | path ending in `.htsl` |

<details>
<summary>Accepted values for <code>event</code> (18)</summary>

`Player Join`, `Player Quit`, `Player Death`, `Player Kill`, `Player Respawn`, `Group Change`, `PvP State Change`, `Fish Caught`, `Player Enter Portal`, `Player Damage`, `Player Block Break`, `Start Parkour`, `Complete Parkour`, `Player Drop Item`, `Player Pick Up Item`, `Player Change Held Item`, `Player Toggle Sneak`, `Player Toggle Flight`

</details>

<!-- importables-schema:eventImportable END -->

Housing has one action list for each built-in event. The `event` value selects
that list, and `actions` supplies its complete desired contents.

```json
{
  "events": [
    {
      "event": "Player Join",
      "actions": "src/events/player_join.htsl"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Region

<!-- importables-schema:regionImportable START -->
<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-importables-doc.mjs. Do not edit this block. -->

Nested fields marked required are required whenever their containing object is present.

| Field | Required | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Yes | string |
| `bounds` | Yes | bounds object |
| `bounds.from` | Yes | position object |
| `bounds.from.x` | Yes | integer |
| `bounds.from.y` | Yes | integer |
| `bounds.from.z` | Yes | integer |
| `bounds.to` | Yes | position object |
| `bounds.to.x` | Yes | integer |
| `bounds.to.y` | Yes | integer |
| `bounds.to.z` | Yes | integer |
| `onEnterActions` | No | path ending in `.htsl` |
| `onExitActions` | No | path ending in `.htsl` |

<!-- importables-schema:regionImportable END -->

Regions are matched by `name`. `bounds.from` and `bounds.to` are the two
corners of the cuboid; HTSW creates a missing region at those bounds or moves
an existing region when its bounds differ.

Omitting `onEnterActions` or `onExitActions` leaves that action list unchanged.

```json
{
  "regions": [
    {
      "name": "Spawn",
      "bounds": {
        "from": { "x": 0, "y": 100, "z": 0 },
        "to": { "x": 10, "y": 110, "z": 10 }
      },
      "onEnterActions": "src/regions/spawn_enter.htsl",
      "onExitActions": "src/regions/spawn_exit.htsl"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Item

<!-- importables-schema:itemImportable START -->
<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-importables-doc.mjs. Do not edit this block. -->

| Field | Required | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Yes | string |
| `nbt` | Yes | path ending in `.snbt` |
| `leftClickActions` | No | path ending in `.htsl` |
| `rightClickActions` | No | path ending in `.htsl` |

<!-- importables-schema:itemImportable END -->

An item's `name` is its stable project identifier, used by item fields such as
`giveItem "Magic Wand"`. It is separate from the display name stored in the
SNBT. `leftClickActions` and `rightClickActions` attach Housing interaction
scripts to the item.

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "name": "Magic Wand",
      "nbt": "items/magic_wand.snbt",
      "leftClickActions": "src/items/wand_left.htsl",
      "rightClickActions": "src/items/wand_right.htsl"
    }
  ]
}
```

Plain vanilla items do not need an ITEM importable or an `.snbt` file. This
includes damage variants such as colored wool and stained clay. Reference
those items directly from item fields in HTSL. See
[Vanilla Item Names](vanilla-item-names.md) for the complete list.

## Menu

<!-- importables-schema:menuImportable START -->
<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-importables-doc.mjs. Do not edit this block. -->

Nested fields marked required are required whenever their containing object is present.

| Field | Required | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Yes | string |
| `size` | No | integer from 1 to 6 |
| `slots` | Yes | array of menu slot object |
| `slots[].slot` | Yes | integer from 0 to 53 |
| `slots[].nbt` | Yes | path ending in `.snbt` |
| `slots[].actions` | No | path ending in `.htsl` |

<!-- importables-schema:menuImportable END -->

Menus are matched by `name`. `size` is the number of rows and is changed only
when declared. `slots` is the complete desired set of populated slots. Each
slot contains an SNBT item and may contain a click-action file.

```json
{
  "menus": [
    {
      "name": "Shop",
      "size": 3,
      "slots": [
        {
          "slot": 13,
          "nbt": "src/shop/emerald.snbt",
          "actions": "src/shop/buy_emerald.htsl"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

Open the menu from HTSL with `displayMenu "Shop"`.

## Command

<!-- importables-schema:commandImportable START -->
<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-importables-doc.mjs. Do not edit this block. -->

| Field | Required | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Yes | string |
| `actions` | No | path ending in `.htsl` |
| `mode` | No | one of `Self`, `Targeted` |
| `requiredPriority` | No | integer from 0 to 20 |
| `listed` | No | boolean |

<!-- importables-schema:commandImportable END -->

Commands are matched by `name`, without a leading slash. `Self` mode runs for
the command sender; `Targeted` mode accepts a player target. Omitted settings
use `Self`, priority `0`, and `listed: true`. Omitting `actions` leaves an
existing command's action list unchanged.

```json
{
  "commands": [
    {
      "name": "visit",
      "actions": "src/commands/visit.htsl",
      "mode": "Targeted",
      "requiredPriority": 3,
      "listed": false
    }
  ]
}
```

## NPC

<!-- importables-schema:npcImportable START -->
<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-importables-doc.mjs. Do not edit this block. -->

Nested fields marked required are required whenever their containing object is present.

| Field | Required | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Yes | string |
| `pos` | Yes | position object |
| `pos.x` | Yes | integer |
| `pos.y` | Yes | integer |
| `pos.z` | Yes | integer |
| `leftClickActions` | No | path ending in `.htsl` |
| `rightClickActions` | No | path ending in `.htsl` |
| `leftClickRedirect` | No | boolean |
| `lookAtPlayers` | No | boolean |
| `hideNameTag` | No | boolean |
| `skin` | No | one of `Steve`, `Alex`, `Players Skin` |
| `equipment` | No | NPC equipment object |
| `equipment.helmet` | No | path ending in `.snbt` |
| `equipment.chestplate` | No | path ending in `.snbt` |
| `equipment.leggings` | No | path ending in `.snbt` |
| `equipment.boots` | No | path ending in `.snbt` |
| `equipment.hand` | No | path ending in `.snbt` |

<!-- importables-schema:npcImportable END -->

NPCs are matched by their exact `pos`, not by name. This allows HTSW to rename
and configure the NPC at those coordinates. `equipment` is reserved in the
format but is not currently supported by live Housing import; declaring it
aborts that NPC before any changes are applied.

```json
{
  "npcs": [
    {
      "name": "&aGuide",
      "pos": { "x": 1, "y": 64, "z": -2 },
      "leftClickActions": "src/npcs/guide_left.htsl",
      "rightClickActions": "src/npcs/guide_right.htsl",
      "leftClickRedirect": true,
      "lookAtPlayers": true,
      "hideNameTag": false,
      "skin": "Players Skin"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Team

<!-- importables-schema:teamImportable START -->
<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-importables-doc.mjs. Do not edit this block. -->

| Field | Required | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Yes | string |
| `tag` | No | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9 -]*$` |
| `color` | No | one of 14 accepted strings |
| `friendlyFire` | No | boolean |

<details>
<summary>Accepted values for <code>color</code> (14)</summary>

`Dark Blue`, `Dark Green`, `Dark Aqua`, `Dark Red`, `Dark Purple`, `Gold`, `Gray`, `Dark Gray`, `Blue`, `Green`, `Aqua`, `Red`, `Light Purple`, `Yellow`

</details>

<!-- importables-schema:teamImportable END -->

Teams are matched by `name`. Optional settings are applied when declared and
otherwise leave the corresponding setting unchanged.

```json
{
  "teams": [
    {
      "name": "Red Team",
      "tag": "RED",
      "color": "Red",
      "friendlyFire": false
    }
  ]
}
```

## Group

<!-- importables-schema:groupImportable START -->
<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-importables-doc.mjs. Do not edit this block. -->

| Field | Required | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Yes | string |
| `tag` | No | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9 -]*$` |
| `tagShownInChat` | No | boolean |
| `color` | No | one of 14 accepted strings |
| `priority` | No | integer from 0 to 20 |
| `permissions` | No | permissions object |
| `chatSpeed` | No | one of 11 accepted strings |
| `defaultGameMode` | No | one of `ADVENTURE`, `SURVIVAL`, `CREATIVE` |

<details>
<summary>Accepted values for <code>color</code> (14)</summary>

`Dark Blue`, `Dark Green`, `Dark Aqua`, `Dark Red`, `Dark Purple`, `Gold`, `Gray`, `Dark Gray`, `Blue`, `Green`, `Aqua`, `Red`, `Light Purple`, `Yellow`

</details>

<details>
<summary>Accepted fields for <code>permissions</code> (51)</summary>

`Fly`, `Wood Door`, `Iron Door`, `Wood Trap Door`, `Iron Trap Door`, `Fence Gate`, `Button`, `Lever`, `Use Launch Pads`, `/tp`, `/tp Other Players`, `Jukebox`, `Kick`, `Ban`, `Mute`, `Pet Spawning`, `Build`, `Offline Build`, `Fluid`, `Pro Tools`, `Use Chests`, `Use Ender Chests`, `Item Editor`, `Switch Game Mode`, `Edit Variables`, `Change Player Group`, `Change Gamerules`, `Housing Menu`, `Team Chat Spy`, `Edit Actions`, `Edit Regions`, `Edit Scoreboard`, `Edit Event Actions`, `Edit Commands`, `Edit Functions`, `Edit Inventory Layouts`, `Edit Teams`, `Edit Custom Menus`, `View Analytics`, `View Logger`, `Item: Mailbox`, `Item: Egg Hunt`, `Item: Teleport Pad`, `Item: Launch Pad`, `Item: Action Pad`, `Item: Hologram`, `Item: NPCs`, `Item: Action Button`, `Item: Leaderboard`, `Item: Trash Can`, `Item: Biome Stick`

</details>

<details>
<summary>Accepted values for <code>chatSpeed</code> (11)</summary>

`Off`, `On`, `Slow 1s`, `Slow 2s`, `Slow 3s`, `Slow 5s`, `Slow 10s`, `Slow 15s`, `Slow 30s`, `Slow 45s`, `Slow 60s`

</details>

<!-- importables-schema:groupImportable END -->

Groups are matched by `name`. The `permissions` object is partial: only the
permissions present in it are changed. Other optional settings likewise remain
unchanged when omitted.

```json
{
  "groups": [
    {
      "name": "Builder",
      "tag": "BUILDER",
      "tagShownInChat": true,
      "color": "Aqua",
      "priority": 5,
      "permissions": {
        "Build": true,
        "Use Launch Pads": false
      },
      "chatSpeed": "Slow 3s",
      "defaultGameMode": "CREATIVE"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Includes and project structure

Use `include` to split a house into smaller modules:

```json
{
  "include": [
    "core/import.json",
    "crates/import.json",
    "parkour.import.json"
  ]
}
```

A project might use this layout:

```text
house
├── import.json
├── core
│   ├── src
│   └── import.json
├── crates
│   ├── src
│   └── import.json
└── parkour.import.json
```

HTSW does not require this folder structure. Organize the project however is
most useful, as long as every referenced path resolves from its declaring
`import.json`.
